real_s3.explanation: The unit responds to a horizontally elongated body raised on wheels or legs, seen from the side or at an angle so its long flank and wheels/legs are visible: mostly cars and trucks, with standing four-legged animals (dogs, a weasel) as a weaker related case. The response is strongest for a sharp, well-framed three-quarter or side view, and weak for front/rear views or when the wheels are cropped out.

parsed.explanation: The unit responds to a horizontally elongated body raised on wheels or legs, seen from the side or at an angle so its long flank and wheels/legs are visible: mostly cars and trucks, with standing four-legged animals (dogs, a weasel) as a weaker related case. The response is strongest for a sharp, well-framed three-quarter or side view, and weak for front/rear views or when the wheels are cropped out.
parsed.evidence: Within vehicle classes, 'long body clearly raised on wheels' is the top answer (d +1.06, percentile 100), and wheels hidden or cropped is the bottom (d -1.07, percentile 0). Three-quarter views (d +0.71) and whole-side-with-front-wheel views (d +0.34) are favored, while front/rear views (d -1.05) and toward/away-facing subjects (d -0.90) are disfavored, which fits a response to a visible elongated flank on supports; animals could not be tested because no photos contained them.
parsed.missing_data: Within-class checks on dog and other quadruped photos to confirm the animal half of the description, plus a direct comparison of pure side profiles against three-quarter views.
